summary_markdown:
A discussion arose regarding a claim that 'viewedImpressions were zero for February 2024' from JCD Brazil. Someone noted that the phrasing was incorrect and suggested that while most facilities did have zero viewed impressions, this wasn't limited to February.

Someone fixed the issue and recommended re-importing data for the entire period using new aggregates when available, though old sources could also be used.
decisions: The data source needs correction regarding reported zero viewed impressions.
action_items: Write back to JCD Brazil asking them to try again with the data.
